coverage.title: Add secure Web Search to Claude Desktop with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
coverage.title_vi: Thêm tìm kiếm web an toàn vào Claude Desktop với Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

summary: Claude Desktop on Amazon Bedrock is limited to the model's knowledge cutoff without web search. In this post, we walk through connecting Claude Desktop to Web Search using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, with JWT-based inbound authentication through AWS IAM Identity Center and Amazon Cognito.
title: Add secure Web Search to Claude Desktop with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
